description: This file contains C code implementing X.509 v3 certificate extensions for OpenSSL, including definitions for certificate types and key usage, as well as functions for converting between internal representations and configuration values.

methods.name: i2v_ASN1_BIT_STRING
methods.description: Converts ASN1_BIT_STRING to a stack of configuration values, listing set bits.

methods.name: v2i_ASN1_BIT_STRING
methods.description: Converts a stack of configuration values to an ASN1_BIT_STRING, setting bits accordingly.
